title: IT security organisational framework
text: Each bureau/department shall define its IT security organisational framework, together with the roles and responsibilities attached to it.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Adaptive security protection
text: Security protection shall be kept responsive and adaptive as the operating environment and technology change.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Departmental IT security policy
text: Each bureau/department shall promulgate and enforce its own IT security policy, using the Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) as the basis for that policy.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Security awareness and training
text: Information security is the responsibility of every staff member; staff shall receive appropriate awareness training and regular refreshers on the IT security policy.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Asset inventory
text: An inventory of information systems, hardware, software, valid warranties, service agreements and legal or contractual documents shall be owned, kept and maintained.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Information classification and handling
text: Bureau/department shall comply with government requirements on information classification, labelling and handling.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Storage media control
text: The use and transportation of storage media holding classified information shall be managed and controlled.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Least privilege
text: The least privilege principle shall be enforced when assigning system resources and privileges to users.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Documented access management procedures
text: Procedures for approving, granting and managing user access, covering user registration and de-registration, password delivery and password reset, shall be documented.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Restriction of special privileges
text: The use of special or privileged access rights shall be restricted and controlled.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Periodic access rights review
text: User privileges and data access rights shall be clearly defined and reviewed periodically at a documented frequency, with records of approval and review retained.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Revocation of access rights
text: All user privileges and data access rights shall be revoked after a pre-defined period of inactivity or once no longer required; the inactivity period and review frequency shall be documented.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Unique user identity
text: Each user identity shall identify exactly one user. Shared or group user IDs are not permitted unless explicitly approved by the DITSO.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: User accountability
text: Users are responsible for all activity performed under their own user IDs.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Proportionate authentication
text: Authentication shall be performed in a manner commensurate with the sensitivity of the information being accessed.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Log-in attempt control
text: Consecutive unsuccessful log-in attempts shall be controlled, for example through account lockout or an increasing delay between attempts.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Mobile computing and remote access
text: Usage policies and procedures shall specify the security requirements for mobile computing and remote access, and measures shall prevent unauthorised access to or disclosure of information held on those devices. Authorised users shall be briefed on the threats and acknowledge their responsibilities.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: IoT device security
text: Security measures for IoT devices and the data they handle shall be commensurate with the classification of that information.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Cryptographic key management
text: Cryptographic keys shall be managed across their whole life cycle, including generation, storage, archiving, retrieval, distribution, retirement and destruction.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Least functionality
text: Information systems shall be managed on the principle of least functionality, with unnecessary services and components removed or restricted.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Anti-malware protection
text: Anti-malware protection shall be enabled on LAN servers, personal computers, mobile devices and any computer connecting to the government internal network over a remote access channel.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Regular backups
text: Backups shall be carried out at regular intervals.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Logging policy and retention
text: Policies on logging system activity, including the log retention period, shall be defined and documented according to business needs and data classification.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Audit-supporting log content
text: Retained logs shall contain enough information to support comprehensive audits of the effectiveness of, and compliance with, security measures.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Vulnerability management process
text: Vulnerability management processes shall identify, evaluate, mitigate and track vulnerabilities across information systems.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Risk-based patch management
text: A patch management strategy covering patch checking and patching frequency shall be set according to risk, scheduling each patch by its potential impact and likelihood of exploitation.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Threat identification and monitoring
text: A threat identification, detection and monitoring mechanism shall be established and regularly reviewed for effectiveness against the nature of the systems and advances in technology.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Log review and integrity
text: Log records, particularly for systems processing or storing classified information, shall be checked regularly for both completeness and integrity; suspected security-related errors shall be reported and logged.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Protection of network information
text: Internal network addresses, configurations and related system or network information shall be maintained and shall not be publicly released without the approval of the bureau/department concerned.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Protection of network boundaries
text: All internal networks connected to other government networks or to publicly accessible networks shall be properly protected.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Encrypted transmission of classified information
text: Information classified above CONFIDENTIAL shall be transmitted only under encryption and within an isolated LAN approved by the Government Security Officer with the technical endorsement of the DPO.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Outsourcing risk assessment
text: Where external services or facilities are used, the risks to government data and business operations shall be identified and assessed, and security measures, service levels and management requirements shall be commensurate with the data classification.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Ongoing monitoring of service providers
text: External service providers shall be monitored and reviewed so that their operations are documented and properly managed, and confidentiality and non-disclosure agreements are maintained and reviewed when changes occur.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Audit rights over service providers
text: Audit and compliance monitoring rights shall be reserved so that service providers can be shown to have implemented sufficient controls, or a security audit report shall be obtained instead.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Data return and destruction on exit
text: All government data held by external services or facilities shall be cleared or destroyed to government requirements at service expiry or termination, or on request of the Government.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Cloud restrictions for classified data
text: Information classified RESTRICTED or above shall not be stored in or processed by public cloud services. Before contracting a cloud provider, the shared responsibilities of both parties shall be clearly defined.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Incident detection and monitoring
text: An incident detection and monitoring mechanism shall be established to detect, contain and ultimately prevent security incidents.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Incident evidence retention
text: System logs and other supporting information shall be retained so that security incidents can be proven and traced.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Incident response plan
text: A security incident response plan shall be established, documented, tested and maintained for information systems.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Staff awareness of the response plan
text: Staff shall be made aware of the incident response plan in place and shall observe and follow it.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Immediate incident reporting
text: Any observed or suspected security incident or problem shall be reported immediately to the responsible party and handled under the incident handling procedure.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Disaster recovery planning
text: Disaster recovery plans shall be planned, implemented and regularly reviewed so that adequate security measures apply during and after a disruption.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Resilience and availability
text: Adequate resilience shall be provided to meet the availability requirements of IT services and facilities.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Statutory and contractual register
text: All relevant statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements applicable to each information system shall be identified and documented.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance
text: The Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486) shall be observed when handling personal data, and all personal data should be classified RESTRICTED or above.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Biennial risk assessment
text: Security risk assessments, and privacy impact assessments where personal data is involved, shall be performed for information systems and production applications at least once every two years.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025

title: Biennial security audit
text: Information systems shall be audited at least once every two years to confirm compliance with IT security policy and effective implementation of security measures, with auditor selection preserving objectivity and impartiality.
version: Hong Kong DPO Baseline IT Security Policy (S17) v8.2, April 2025
